# ARC Explainer

> Independent community resources for ARC-AGI: interactive games, game guides, research, Kaggle standings and archived model evaluations.

## Start here

- [Resource hub](https://arc.markbarney.net/home): public sections and related projects.
- [ARC-AGI-3 Kaggle leaderboard](https://arc.markbarney.net/kaggle-leaderboard): public standings, team history and changes. Public medal bands are not final private results.
- [ARC-AGI-2 Kaggle leaderboard](https://arc.markbarney.net/kaggle-leaderboard/arc-2): separate competition data and history.
- [ARC-AGI-3 game guides](https://arc.markbarney.net/arc3/games): 25 official public demonstration games; withdrawn preview game as66 is separately labeled.
- [Game guides in Markdown](https://arc.markbarney.net/arc3/games.md): the same shared registry, organized level by level. Full spoilers.
- [Slippery Seven](https://arc.markbarney.net/arc3/slippery-seven): the dated September 16, 2026 Qwen 27B experiment, not a claim that the games remain unsolved.
- [Human and AI results](https://arc.markbarney.net/human-records.html): published runs and their provenance.
- [Community tasks](https://arc.markbarney.net/arc3/gallery): discover the rules by playing.
- [Model hypotheses research](https://arc.markbarney.net/arc3/hypotheses): reasoning from an unseen game frame.
- [ARC puzzle browser](https://arc.markbarney.net/browser): ARC-1 and ARC-2 grids and model answers.
- [Model analytics archive](https://arc.markbarney.net/analytics): previously imported ARC Prize Hugging Face results, not a feed of new official evaluations.
- [Human ARC](https://arc.markbarney.net/human-arc/): the independently maintained puzzle and assessment application.
- [About](https://arc.markbarney.net/about): project background.

## Context

Public demo game performance is not a proxy for the private competition set. Game guides contain spoilers; play first when contributing a blind human baseline. Game IDs are the stable identifiers. Community task answer keys are deliberately unlisted and excluded by robots.txt. This document is a discovery guide, not an access-control or crawler-policy file.

[Generated sitemap](https://arc.markbarney.net/sitemap.xml) · [Crawler policy](https://arc.markbarney.net/robots.txt)
